philosophy: Add orthogonal point-in-time information only; no selector, label, threshold, corporate-action, or P100 production-rule tuning.

new_model_features.name: evt_opportunity_180
new_model_features.definition: decayed positive score from order_win, capacity_expansion, debt_reduction, buyback, positive credit_rating

new_model_features.name: evt_risk_180
new_model_features.definition: decayed adverse score from dilution, auditor_change, litigation, regulatory, negative credit_rating, adverse pledge_change

new_model_features.name: evt_promoter_180
new_model_features.definition: decayed signed promoter_activity and pledge_change event score

new_model_features.name: evt_intensity_90
new_model_features.definition: log1p count of material classified events in prior 90 calendar days

new_model_features.name: evt_recency_net_90
new_model_features.definition: signed exponentially decayed event_direction*strength over prior 90 days

new_model_features.name: promoter_pct
new_model_features.definition: latest promoter/promoter-group percentage whose broadcast timestamp is no later than snapshot

new_model_features.name: promoter_delta_qoq
new_model_features.definition: latest point-in-time promoter percentage minus prior disclosed quarter

new_model_features.name: insider_net_180
new_model_features.definition: signed log1p transaction-value score for acquisitions minus disposals in prior 180 days

new_model_features.name: insider_activity_180
new_model_features.definition: log1p count of PIT transactions in prior 180 days

new_model_features.name: result_delay_days
new_model_features.definition: days from reported quarter end to latest financial-result broadcast available at snapshot

new_model_features.name: result_revision_180
new_model_features.definition: indicator/count of revised financial-result filings within prior 180 days

leakage_rules: Use broadcast/published timestamps as availability time, never period-end date alone.
Snapshot may use only records available no later than that snapshot date.
No outcome labels or future prices influence feature construction.
Same corporate-action identity/integrity rules as V10.2.
failure_policy: Do not tune feature weights/thresholds to force a pass. Keep V10.2 production if V10.4 fails.

feature_implementation.event_availability: published_ts converted to Asia/Kolkata calendar date; only records available on/before snapshot date
feature_implementation.shareholding_availability: broadcastDate; period-end date never used as availability
feature_implementation.financial_availability: broadCastDate; toDate used only for filing-delay calculation
feature_implementation.missing_history_policy: leave ownership/fundamental values missing for imputation; event/insider activity defaults to zero only when no qualifying prior event exists
